basis: Completes all 12 August 4 objectives from the two original assigned PDFs. Each answer begins with three Quick answer bullets, followed by independently collapsed short fact topics and original reader links first in the collapsed sources. Necessary clinical updates are labeled; detailed fertility assessment is a visibly labeled guideline supplement because no dedicated infertility/genetics lecture was supplied. No fictional cases, new drug-dose table or universal local protocol is invented.

visualReview.purpose: Reviewed effectiveness image, dated missed-use table, barrier diagrams, reversed calendar formula, mucus/calendar diagrams and sterilization figures. A baby-with-IUD photograph supplies no failure-rate estimate.

emphasis.handling: Exact scoped bold spans in the existing safe formatting layer. No raw Markdown or HTML in note data; all earlier additions and CSV decisions preserved.

materialLimits.handling: No dedicated infertility/genetic-counseling PDF was supplied. Original reproductive-goal counseling and STI/PID tubal-risk context are retained; every detailed assessment/referral topic is explicitly labeled a guideline supplement, not attributed to a missing lecture.

Original abortion medication/law slides are outside the existing 12 objectives and are not expanded. Consent requirements remain jurisdiction/funding-specific; no dated universal waiting period is prescribed.

Product-specific scenarios are answered by explicit decision boundaries; no patient facts or fictional worked case is added. Current CDC guidance and ANNOVERA label are clearly separated from the older lecture table.
Treatment concepts and named prescribed medicines are covered; dose selection, exceptions, drug-interaction management and individual orders remain with the actual clinician/local plan.

clarifications.issue: Dated method durations and broad IUD exclusions
clarifications.handling: Nexplanon updated to five years using the 2026 FDA label; LNG-IUD brands retain distinct contraceptive durations and copper labeled ten years. Nulliparity/short future pregnancy plans are not automatic contraindications.

clarifications.issue: Universal hormonal safety, backup and missed-use rules
clarifications.handling: Separate estrogen risk and current breast-cancer eligibility; distinguish POP formulations, combined pills, patch, etonogestrel/EE ring and ANNOVERA timing. Review exact medicines rather than claiming all antibiotics cause failure.

clarifications.issue: Reversed calendar arithmetic and incomplete lactational amenorrhea criteria
clarifications.handling: Correct shortest minus 18/longest minus 11; explain temperature limitations and all LAM criteria including feeding gaps.

clarifications.issue: Older EC windows, packaging/mechanism claims, sterilization consent and clearance
clarifications.handling: Use timely method-specific EC and restart; distinguish prevention from ending established pregnancy. Emphasize voluntary permanence and semen clearance rather than universal consent days, ejaculation counts or three-month HSG for every tubal procedure.

clarifications.issue: No dedicated infertility or genetics lecture
clarifications.handling: Use ASRM assessment/referral guidance in explicitly labeled supplement topics; retain original reproductive-goal and tubal-infection context and avoid invented course content.

clarifications.issue: STI diagnosis/treatment shortcuts, Candida units and outdated BV partner teaching
clarifications.handling: Use NAAT/site-based testing and distinguish BV/yeast; pregnancy topical azoles; avoid microgram typo. Label 2025 recurrent-BV partner-treatment update and distinguish three-month retesting from cure tests.

clarifications.issue: HSV type/transmission/neonatal risks, syphilis stage-independent therapy and old HPV vaccine
clarifications.handling: Both HSV types can be genital; distinguish near-delivery acquisition from recurrent history. Use stage-specific penicillin and pregnancy desensitization, current 9-valent HPV vaccine and age-based schedules.
Clinical early empiric treatment, pregnancy/emergency assessment, selected admission and documented 72-hour reassessment.

clarifications.issue: HIV U=U overgeneralization, fixed infant regimen and hepatitis transmission errors
clarifications.handling: Distinguish sexual U=U from breastmilk risk, use late-pregnancy viral load and risk-based neonatal plans, clarify HBV vaccine/HBIG and HCV infant RNA testing, and distinguish hepatitis types/feeding guidance.

sharedViews: All 12 answers appear in August 4. Six also populate the existing Contraception exam topic and five the STI exam topic; fertility remains weekly-only as originally mapped. Reader articles derive the same notes. All earlier notes, objective order/prompts/mappings, original PDFs/previews, media, practice banks/access and navigation/materials layout are preserved.
limits: Source-led study notes with labeled current guidance, not an individualized order set, independent clinical validation or physical-device Safari test.
